repository_note: Local working copy is a git clone whose HEAD equals origin/main (verified with git ls-remote); tracked tree clean. Used in place instead of a second clone so that the 759 MB TM pseudopotential set and the archived baseline results stay co-located.
host: baekdu (KIAS), CPU-only Slurm cluster; SelectTypeParameters=CR_CORE (memory not used for placement)
documented_deviations_from_README: PyTorch installed as the CPU build instead of the CUDA 11.8 wheel: no GPU exists on any partition.
scipy and matplotlib added: 18 vendored gospel modules import scipy; matplotlib is needed by the repository plotting scripts.
README usage example '--outerorder dynamic' fails against the current PreNeumann.__init__; sanity check run with '--outerorder 4'.

production_code_changes.description: Disabled-by-default probe hooks (spectral_probe, term_probe), an apply_P helper, and an inert Davidson metadata/subspace hook. All guarded by 'is not None'.
production_code_changes.regression: With the probe disabled, output is BITWISE IDENTICAL to the unmodified code (max|d eigval| = 0.0, max|d residual| = 0.0), re-verified after every code change including the final one.

gates.Gate 0 (numerical baseline): passed - B12 order 4 seed 2: 27 vs 27 Davidson iterations, converged bands agree to 2.7e-8 Ha
gates.Gate 1 (operator validation): passed - delta_apply_P = 0.0, delta_recurrence ~ 4e-16 in every production run, dense 1000x1000 cross-check

failures: 326536, 326537: debug partition rejects this account (immediate FAILED, signal 53). Switched to 'normal'.

326976, 327004: MAPbI3 out-of-memory. Cause: SelectTypeParameters=CR_CORE means --mem is ignored for placement, so two large jobs shared node b79. Fixed by reducing the probe footprint (see below) and rerun successfully.
slurm_jobs.probe_memory_fix: The probe originally cloned whole recurrence-term blocks (~35 GB for MAPbI3). Rewritten to store only the selected columns (~0.2 GB); verified to give identical results.

retracted_during_the_work: Section 8.5: the near-equality of lambda_max across the 0-D systems was first attributed to the GAPP t_sample; the actual cause is the indefiniteness of M (section 12).
Section 9: the projected-spectrum result was first read as refuting the 'irrelevant unstable modes' hypothesis; rho_proj cannot measure modal weight, so no conclusion is drawn from it.

Section 10: eta_N was first used as the figure of merit and its minimum as the optimal order; eta measures the error of a linear solve Davidson does not want, and the growth occurs along directions Davidson deflates.
Section 20.3b: rho and (kappa-1)/(kappa+1) were conflated; they coincide only when alpha=1 is the optimal Richardson scaling, which holds only at N=0 for the 0-D systems.

final_campaigns.primary_design: capture at the first preconditioner call where every analysed state's residual norm is below 1e-3, using the Davidson Ritz value itself as the shift (--probe_resid_below 1e-3 --exact_shift); no iteration choice to justify

headline.convergence: rho(Pi E Pi) <= 0.949-0.982 for HOMO/middle in all four systems and for MAPbI3/lowest; > 1 (1.07-1.14) for the lowest state of the other three
headline.threshold: lambda_min(Pi E Pi) crosses -1 at eps_tilde ~ -0.89 Ha in every 0-D system (-0.8863/-0.8894/-0.8915), i.e. 20-27 % of occupied bands; framed in the response as evidence that the boundary belongs to the GAPP parameterisation, not as the claim itself -- the claim is the general inequality mu_max(Pi P M Pi) < 2
headline.conditioning: geometric mean over 46 bands falls 7.11 (N=2) -> 3.11 (N=8), 2.3x, but kappa REVERSES beyond its minimum in all 18 iteration/shift snapshots while the archived iteration count does not; the condition-number analysis was therefore REMOVED from the reviewer response in full (report.md 23.3, 23.6) and survives only in SI Table S1
headline.damping: at the lowest state the undamped error norm grows 1.26-1.28 -> 2.47-4.41 while the damped one falls 0.98-1.00 -> 0.44-0.54; damped contracts in 42/44 orders, undamped in 11/44
headline.chebyshev: Damped-NP within 1.2-4.0x of the optimal same-degree polynomial with no spectral bounds required
headline.jacobi-davidson: implemented and JD forms agree to 4.8 % (13/16 within 1 %)
headline.shift_convention: exact vs corrected shift agree to three decimals at i_iter 12 and 18; they differ only at i_iter 6, where c|gamma|^2 is 1.7-10.9 % of the shift (report.md 23.2)
headline.deflation_necessity: undeflated kappa(Pbar_N M) is inconclusive at every order (sigma_min does not converge; M near-singular by design) and WORSENS with order, e.g. B12 >100 at N=2 to >242 at N=10, while the deflated one improves to N=6 (report.md 23.4)

rigour_audit.exact_by_interlacing: kappa >= sqrt(theta_max/theta_min); sigma_min <= sqrt(theta_min); sigma_max >= sqrt(theta_max)
rigour_audit.numerically_certified_not_proved: upper ends of the brackets and rho <= ||A^n||^(1/n), which rest on the Lanczos run having converged to the extremal value
rigour_audit.convergence_evidence: m-independence m=20-100 (8 digits), dense cross-check (5 digits), two independent campaigns (median 0.05 % over 29 points), safe degradation to 'inconclusive' when sigma_min is unconverged
